It earns from trading commissions, from financing client balances, and from selling access to its own execution venue. Where the advantage sits Read through the 7 Powers, the durable position here is switching costs: client balances are slow to move and slower to re-onboard. What is holding it back The binding constraint is operational rather than commercial. Module maturity across the assessed modules (0–100).
